svg.title: AI publication pipeline
svg.desc: Model-authored content, runtime validation policy and explicit delivery outcomes
svg.text: AI publication pipeline
Model-authored content, runtime validation policy and explicit delivery outcomes
1. Select and freeze
Account due time and weighted preset
Immutable rules, selected models and inputs
2. Read and draft
Persist source snapshots
Approved AI finalizes the complete body
3. Validate by runtime mode
Strict: rules, optional review and repair
Publish first: content warnings
4. Prepare image
Library or approved GPT Image 2
Ingest and validate actual bytes / provenance
5. Final gate and intent
Account, pause, lease and AI integrity
Commit intent before sending
6. Submit once
Confirmed: save ID and next due time
Unknown: retain intent, never blind resend
Preview stops before upload. Public verification does not trigger resubmission.
Publish first still requires nonempty bounded text, authentic AI evidence, valid media, account state and duplicate prevention.
Uncertain delivery is an explicit state; only read-only reconciliation may associate the original remote submission.
Square Desk | Implemented behavior | 2026-10-22 | Native services, no Docker / WSL
